msg: Hi - I didn't work out any reliable pattern I'm afraid. The previous participant advised me to avoid the tall brown hat and aim for pink/purple but I don't think this helped a great deal. The tall brown sometimes gave 0's but also sometimes gave high scores. All I can say is try to follow your instincts and if you are in a run of low scores then switch up your selection a bit. And make sure you don't miss any clicks. Good luck.
